description: Define when a package surface may leave the monorepo and how to extract it with history, registry continuity, CI proof, and rollback.

support_scope.summary: Defines repo split eligibility, history-preserving extraction, registry continuity, CI proof, and rollback requirements. It does not perform a split or create external repositories.

gap_register.summary: Actual extraction work is intentionally out of scope until a package surface is approved as a split candidate.
